turn.content: Records gathered. The contract's price list (Lampiran A) sets PO prices and the only addendum covers a different item, so nothing authorises the higher price.

tool_calls.name: submit_report
tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "price_mismatch", "line": 1, "cause": "overcharge", "evidence": [{"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0185", "detail": "PO line 1 'Mesin Kopi Otomatis', quantity 1, unit price 6,107,900 IDR — below the invoiced 6,390,200."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-025#2.1", "detail": "Unit prices are those in Lampiran A and stay fixed for the term of the agreement; no contract price of 6,390,200 exists for this item."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-025#2.2", "detail": "Price changes are valid only via a written addendum signed by both parties and are not retroactive."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-025#11.1", "detail": "The only price addendum (effective 1 September 2026) covers Air Mineral Galon 19L at 22,600 IDR, not the invoiced coffee machine."}, {"kind": "goods_receipt", "ref": "GR-2026-0185", "detail": "Received 1 unit of 'Mesin Kopi Otomatis' on 2026-09-23; billing position shows invoicing of 7,093,122 exceeds value received with tax of 6,779,769."}], "explanation": "The invoice bills line 1 at 6,390,200 against the PO price of 6,107,900, and no contract clause or addendum permits a higher price for this item, so the excess is an overcharge rather than a contract-set price."}]}
